judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— Writ of Mandamus had been instituted to direct the respondents 3 to 8 to remove the encroachments by way of unauthorized construction consisting of ground floor encroaching the 60 feet wide park road, on the western side, in the land in Old S.No. 11/3B3 and New S.No. 3B3B, Padi Village, Ambattur Taluk, Chennai, pursuant to the communication dated 07.06.2022 of the 5th Respondent addressed to the 8th Respondent, with a copy marked to the 7th Respondent, by considering the representation dated 18.04.2022.

2. Learned Additional Government Pleader furnished a copy of the order passed by the District Revenue Officer, Chennai, dated 18.07.2025. The District Revenue Officer, had conducted a detailed enquiry by affording opportunity to all the parties and by recording their statement and considering the documents produced by the partiesand found that a dispute exists between the parties and was unable to form an opinion that the subject land is a government land. Therefore, relegated the parties to approach the civil court.

3. Disputed facts relating to civil rights cannot be adjudicated in writ proceedings. Therefore, this Court does not find any infirmity in the order passed by the District Revenue Officer. Granting liberty to the parties to approach the Civil Court, the Writ Petition stands dismissed. No costs.
